name: Six Pieces ~Tajuu Choukyou~
source:
Main character is a magic doctor who performs indecent experiments on his patients with the use of various instruments and even creatures. It's possible to imbue girls with one of six personalities.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名魔法醫師，使用各種器械甚至生物，對患者進行淫穢實驗。玩家可以替女孩植入六種人格之一。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
